outcome0 AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER () AS k,n.file,n.id AS node,9223372036854775807 AS work,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.file ORDER BY n.id) AS ordinal FROM node n WHERE 1 AND n.kind IN (180,181,201,216,218)
),
outcome1 AS (
SELECT NULL AS k,file,NULL AS node,0 AS ordinal,0 AS truth,9223372036854775807 AS work FROM outcome0 GROUP BY file
UNION ALL
SELECT d.k,d.file,d.node,d.ordinal,r.c0,r.c1 FROM outcome1 w CROSS JOIN outcome0 d ON d.file=w.file AND d.ordinal=w.ordinal+1 CROSS JOIN relation_row r ON (r.c0,r.c1) IS (WITH RECURSIVE outcome0 AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT 1 AS k,d.file AS file,d.node AS node,w.work AS work WHERE 1
),
outcome1 AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT d.k,d.file,d.node,d.work,0 AS truth,0 AS open FROM outcome0 d
),
outcome2 AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT d.*,r.c0 AS tested,r.c1 AS remaining FROM outcome1 d CROSS JOIN relation_row r ON (r.c0,r.c1) IS (WITH RECURSIVE outcome0 AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT 1 AS k,d.file AS file,d.node AS node,d.work AS work WHERE d.truth=0
),
outcome1 AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT d.k,d.file,d.node,d.work,1 AS truth FROM outcome0 d
),
outcome2 AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT d.*,d.work AS remaining,CASE WHEN d.truth>0 AND NOT (0) THEN CASE WHEN (n.kind IN (201)) OR (n.kind IN (180)) OR (n.kind IN (181)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE NULL END AS tested FROM outcome1 d CROSS JOIN node n ON n.file=d.file AND n.id=d.node
),
outcome3 AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT d.k,d.file,d.node,COALESCE(d.remaining,d.work) AS work,CASE WHEN d.truth<0 THEN d.truth WHEN d.tested<0 THEN d.tested WHEN d.truth=0 OR d.tested=0 THEN 0 WHEN d.truth=2 OR d.tested=2 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS truth FROM outcome2 d
),
outcome4 AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT d.*,r.c0 AS tested,r.c1 AS remaining FROM outcome3 d CROSS JOIN relation_row r ON (r.c0,r.c1) IS (WITH RECURSIVE outcome0 AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT 1 AS k,d.file AS file,d.node AS node,d.work AS work WHERE d.truth>0 AND NOT (0)
),
outcome1 AS MATERIALIZED (

UNION ALL
SELECT w.k,w.file,w.node,w.bound,1, CASE WHEN w.stopped<0 THEN 0 WHEN w.work=0 THEN -2 ELSE COALESCE(r.c0,0) END,w.stopped,w.low,w.uncertain,w.open,COALESCE(r.c1,w.work) FROM outcome1 w CROSS JOIN node n ON n.file=w.file AND n.id=w.node CROSS JOIN outcome0 d ON d.k=w.k CROSS JOIN relation_row r ON (r.c0,r.c1) IS (SELECT CASE WHEN probe.kind IN (184) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,w.work-1 FROM node probe WHERE probe.file=w.file AND probe.id=n.id AND (w.stopped>=0 AND w.work>0)) WHERE w.phase=0

UNION ALL
SELECT w.k,w.file,CASE WHEN (n.next)<=w.bound THEN (n.next) END,w.bound,0,0,0,(w.low+(w.own=1)),(w.uncertain+(w.own=2)),(w.open OR w.stopped=2),w.work FROM outcome1 w CROSS JOIN node n ON n.file=w.file AND n.id=w.node WHERE w.phase=2 AND NOT (w.own<0 OR w.stopped<0 OR (w.own=1 AND (w.low+(w.own=1))>=2)) AND (CASE WHEN (n.next)<=w.bound THEN (n.next) END) IS NOT NULL
),

),

),
outcome3 AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT d.k,d.file,d.node,COALESCE(d.remaining,d.work) AS work,CASE WHEN d.truth<0 THEN d.truth WHEN d.tested<0 THEN d.tested WHEN d.truth=0 OR d.tested=0 THEN 0 WHEN d.truth=2 OR d.tested=2 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS truth FROM outcome2 d
),
outcome4 AS MATERIALIZED (

),
outcome1 AS MATERIALIZED (

),

),
